mainEntity.name: What information should I give a developer before building my AI business directory?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a developer, prepare the directory’s purpose, target users, listing fields, sample records, categories, search behavior, roles, approval rules, integrations, and launch priorities. Also decide what the system must not do without approval, such as publishing, emailing, charging, or changing listings. Context: AI-assisted development still depends on precise requirements and supporting services; prompts alone do not create a complete operating system. Key factors: data ownership, accessibility, mobile behavior, security expectations, reporting, maintenance, and handoff documentation. Practical guidance: ask for a clickable prototype, technical plan, milestone estimate, test plan, and post-launch support terms. Require clear ownership of code, data, prompts, accounts, and documentation. Run My AI Business’s planning materials can help a first-time owner turn a broad idea into a developer-ready brief.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide the audience, directory purpose, listing schema, categories, sample records, search and filter rules, user roles, approval steps, integrations, monetization plan, and launch scope. Also document actions requiring approval and ownership of code, data, prompts, accounts, and ongoing support.
